issue_title: Persistent sub-85 performance on / and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (LCP bottleneck)
issue_body: ## Performance regression — persistent LCP bottleneck Two pages have remained below the 85 Lighthouse performance threshold for **four consecutive nightly audits**. TBT has improved markedly but LCP is still the primary drag. | Page | Perf | LCP | TBT | CLS | |------|------|-----|-----|-----| | `/` | 82 | 4086 ms | 70 ms | 0.015 | | `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 80 | 4393 ms | 92 ms | 0 | ### Recommended fixes 1. **`fetchpriority="high"`** on each page's LCP `` element — ensures the browser prioritises the hero image over other in-flight requests. 2. **Preload the LCP image** with `` in the document ``. 3. **Check image sizing/format** — confirm hero images are served as WebP/AVIF at an appropriate resolution for mobile viewports. 4. For `/`, investigate whether the animated hero section delays LCP discovery; consider inlining critical CSS for above-the-fold content. ### Audit history - 2026-10-06: / perf 82, screenshot-to-primevue perf 79 - 2026-10-07: / perf 82, screenshot-to-primevue perf 79 - 2026-10-08: / perf 83, screenshot-to-primevue perf 77 - 2026-10-09: / perf 82, screenshot-to-primevue perf 80 _Automatically filed by nightly auditor — 2026-10-09T15:17:25.330Z_
